confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied calibration cities; no live listings or booking pages were checked, and web search was used only for the FX observation. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by season, location and booking channel, and July is summer beach season, so beachfront rates may sit at the upper end. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from the local beer relationship (about 3.3x and 3.75x the draught beer anchor) because direct knowledge of those prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against the supplied Vientiane, Phuket and Penang observations rather than copying any one city. Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors sit close to Vientiane and well below Phuket and Penang. The mid-range meal sits above Vientiane and Penang but well below Phuket. Private-room and basic-hotel anchors sit below Vientiane, and the three-star tier falls between Vientiane and Phuket. Vietnam's generally lower cost level was used as the regional basis.
